changelog: Thirteen pages: Dashboard, Citizens, Vehicles, Reports, Incidents, Charges, Dispatch, Live GPS, Roster, Evidence, Cameras, Bulletins and Admin
Citizen dossiers with criminal records, warrants, licences, notes, owned vehicles and booking photos
Incidents and reports that link suspects, officers, charges, fines and jail time from the penal code
Dispatch feed for 911 calls with map blips and an AddCall export other resources can push to
Live GPS map with on-duty unit tracking, 10-8 / 10-7 duty toggle and an officer-down panic alert
Mugshot and photo capture built into the tablet itself, no external screenshot resource, uploaded via webhook, FiveManage or your own host
Bodycam item with a wearable clothing component, attach animation and an on-screen recording HUD
CCTV cameras placed in-world with a command, saved to the database and watched from the Cameras page
ANPR plate scanning with IsPlateWanted and AnprScan exports, plus BOLO plates and bulletins
Per-job, per-grade permissions for every page and every action in permissions.json, editable live from the Admin page with an audit log
Discord webhooks per event with their own URLs and colours: reports, evidence, warrants, fines, panic, duty, mugshots and more
Opened by command, inventory item or an optional rebindable key, with a tablet prop and animation
QBox, QB-Core, ESX and standalone, ox_inventory support, 10 languages set in the config
